Description

Sheen Way Playing Fields is a well-used community sports facility located in Wallington, Greater London, offering a spacious 9-a-side football pitch suitable for both casual and competitive play. The pitch is ideal for youth teams, local clubs, school fixtures, and training sessions, providing a quality playing surface in a convenient South London setting.

Bookings are available for one-off matches or as part of a regular block booking, making it easy for teams and organisers to secure a consistent slot throughout the season. Whether you're planning a single friendly game or setting up weekly fixtures, the flexible hire options cater to a variety of needs.

There is free parking available around the surrounding streets, so players and spectators can attend without worrying about permits or additional fees. The facility also includes access to changing rooms, offering teams a comfortable space to get ready before kick-off and to cool down after the game.

Sheen Way Playing Fields combines accessibility, convenience, and essential amenities to create a reliable venue for 9-a-side football. It’s a great option for grassroots clubs, community teams, and schools looking for a local pitch in the Wallington area.
